# aeneid-029 — new house renderings

| line | Latin | `l` | `i` |
|---|---|---|---|
| IV.569–570 | *Varium et mutabile semper femina* | "Changeable and fickle always a woman" | "Always a wavering, shifting creature is woman." |

Built from the Latin; not in the conventions' list of set pieces but one of the poem's best-known lines. Checked against memory of familiar versions for verbatim echo and kept distinct from the common "fickle and changeable thing".
